name: Aygaz A.S.
summary: Aygaz A.S., an integrated LPG company, engages in the purchase of liquid petroleum gas (LPG) and deliver it to retailers for distribution to customers in Turkey and internationally. It operates through three segments: LPG and Gas, Cargo Transportation and Distribution, and Refining and Electricity. The company manufactures LPG cylinders and tanks, regulators, and other supplementary materials; and retails and wholesales LPG, fuel, and lubricants through its autogas stations. It also engages in the purchase and sale of natural gas; arrangement for modulation and storing of natural gas; and building of necessary facilities.
